summary: One region from 54.58 to 58.84 seconds showed unusually low pitch variation, making the delivery flat or monotone.
what_happened: From 54.58 seconds to 58.84 seconds (duration 4.26 seconds), the pitch variation was too small, resulting in a flat or monotone delivery; the observed standard deviation of pitch was 0.037 semitones.
why_it_matters: When pitch variation is minimal, the speech can sound monotonous, making it harder for listeners to stay engaged and to perceive emphasis or emotion.
